title: Edit one scene (media / overlay / layout / audio / text / metadata)
description:
Synchronous for most branches, no credit charged until /v1/export_video
re-renders the final MP4. Pick ONE scene by `voice_file` (the stable
per-scene UID — preferred), `id` (display/order, UNSTABLE), or `text`
(fuzzy). Then send exactly ONE field family per call — the only
intentional multi-family call is `layout.batch`, which composes
layout-only children. Branches:
  (A) mediaUrl/mediaType — background media swap (roll-aware)
  (B) remotion.upload_overlay — FREE agent-supplied image → Remotion
      spec (NOT Regenerate Overlay)
  (C) remotion.object.rect — PREFERRED overlay layout (read layout_id
      from /v1/scene_geometry first; uses 280×498 preview coords)
  (D) remotion.group.rect — low-level wrapper edit (canvas or preview)
  (E) overlay.narrator.rect — narrator box layout in 280×498 preview
  (F) overlay.caption.y — vertical-only caption placement in 280×498
  (G) layout.batch — composes E/F/C/D atomically (one persist, one MQTT)
  (H) voice.upload — async; user-supplied narration audio
  (I) narrator.upload_video — async; user-supplied A-roll video
  (J) roll.active / roll.switch — sync A/B-roll data switch
  (K) segment.text — text correction (keeps audio timing)
  (L) metadata — pattern / type / visual / keyword / quote / talking_point
segment.remotion_spec='none' = user-disabled overlay; do NOT auto-enable.

fields.name: value
fields.label: Value matching `by`
fields.help: When by='voice_file' use the scene voice_file from /v1/video_data; by='id' the current segment.id; by='text' a narration snippet.

fields.name: fields
fields.label: fields[] — one family per call (layout.batch composes layout-only children)
fields.help: Pick ONE family. For layout edits, read boxes.remotion.object_layer.objects from /v1/scene_geometry to find layout_id.

fields.name: min_score
fields.label: min_score (only when by='text')
fields.help: Fuzzy-match threshold 0..1. Default 0.5. Lower cautiously for paraphrases; do NOT raise past 0.9.

use_cases.title: (A) Background swap — image, by voice_file
use_cases.description: Most reliable. Roll-aware — B-roll updates mediaUrl/brollUrl; A-roll registers as brollUrl/user_asset_url without disturbing the narrator.

use_cases.title: (A) Background swap — match by narration text, video
use_cases.description: Fuzzy match on the narration. May return a clarification — pick a voice_file and retry.

request.value: Meta đã chi 14.3 tỷ đô để mua Scale AI

use_cases.title: (B) Upload Overlay — agent-supplied PNG → Remotion spec (raster path, FREE)
use_cases.description: NOT Regenerate Overlay (paid). Raster path: classifier-driven graphic-vs-realistic decomposition with strict no-AI fallback. Prefer a portrait 720×1280 transparent PNG; ground the image in scene context (text/talking_point/visual/quote/keyword/type).

use_cases.title: (B) Upload Overlay — agent-authored SVG → svg2spec (PREFERRED, FREE)
use_cases.description: URL ending .svg triggers svg2spec. Required: viewBox 0 0 720 1280. Each `<g data-wc-object="name">` group becomes one Storyboard object with pixel-perfect placement (NO auto-fit). Per-group attrs: data-wc-object (REQUIRED stable id; unmarked groups become background), data-wc-kind ∈ {object,text,bar,mark,callout}, data-wc-anim ∈ {slide-up,slide-down,slide-left,slide-right,pop,grow-x,grow-y,fade,…}, data-wc-z (paint order). Deterministic — no classifier. SVG errors → 422 svg2spec_failed.

use_cases.title: (C) Object-layer rect — preferred overlay layout (one_by_one)
use_cases.description: Read boxes.remotion.object_layer.objects from /v1/scene_geometry; pass the logical *.one_by_one layout_id to transform all timed sequence items together. WideCast keeps the group wrapper unchanged.

use_cases.title: (C) Object-layer rect — move a single overlay text object
use_cases.description: Per-object layout_id (e.g. main.obj_03_text). Server maps the preview rect onto raw Storyboard offsets/sizes.

use_cases.title: (D) Group rect — move whole Storyboard group up by 120px (canvas)
use_cases.description: Low-level wrapper edit — child objects untouched. Canvas (720×1280) is NOT clamped; negative y is allowed.

use_cases.title: (D) Group rect — resize + scale children
use_cases.description: Resize triggers `scale_children`: wrapper + every child object + root background.bbox scale together. `wrapper_only` is advanced.

use_cases.title: (E) Narrator layout rect — 280×498 preview coords
use_cases.description: Preserves narrator metadata + source-space segment.narrator_face. Marks overlay.narrator.touched=true so auto-fit doesn't overwrite. No media/audio/timeline/Remotion-spec changes.

use_cases.title: (F) Caption Y — vertical placement only (280×498)
use_cases.description: ONLY Y — does not change x/w/h, visibility, config, segment.text, segment.words, audio, duration, or Remotion specs.

use_cases.title: (G) Layout batch — multiple layout fields directly
use_cases.description: One persist, one MQTT scene_modified. Allowed children: overlay.narrator.*, overlay.caption.y, remotion.object.rect, remotion.group.rect.

use_cases.title: (G) Layout batch — via the explicit `layout.batch` envelope
use_cases.description: Same composer, alternate request shape. Useful when the orchestrator already knows it's batching.

use_cases.title: (H) Upload Voice — user-supplied audio (ASYNC; queued)
use_cases.description: Free; not Use-AI-Voice. Returns scene_voice_upload_queued + queue_id. Wait for MQTT scene_voice_upload_applied, then call /v1/video_data to verify.

use_cases.title: (I) Upload Narrator Video — user-supplied A-roll (ASYNC; queued)
use_cases.description: Free; user-supplied video. If target is B-roll, server preserves the previous background and switches to A-roll on completion.

use_cases.title: (J) A/B-roll switch — show narrator A-roll
use_cases.description: Sync data switch. Preserves both lanes; swaps the active runtime fields. A→B mirrors the editor's _switched file-family protection.

use_cases.title: (K) Segment text correction
use_cases.description: Rebuilds word timings over existing audio; no duration/timeline change.

fields.value: Meta spent 14.3 billion to acquire Scale AI.

use_cases.title: (L) Scene metadata — validated pattern + quote
use_cases.description: pattern is validated against ai_segment_text canonical values; type ∈ {HOOK, STAT, KEY POINT, DATA, FACT, CALL TO ACTION}. pattern='typography_only' auto-clears visual.

use_cases.title: (M) Remotion add element — bare-string shortcut for kind=text
use_cases.description: Add-only: appends a new Storyboard text object. Returns a new layout_id; follow up with layout.batch + remotion.object.rect to land it inside safe zones.

use_cases.title: (M) Remotion add element — stat with position hint
use_cases.description: kind=stat draws value + label. position picks a server-side default rect on the named side (top/bottom/left/right/center).

use_cases.title: (M) Remotion add element — image with explicit 280×498 preview rect
use_cases.description: kind=image places the URL inline. Use rect to pin the position; coordinate_space defaults to 'preview' (280×498).

use_cases.title: (N) Disable overlay — hide Remotion overlay without deleting the spec
use_cases.description: Sets segment.remotion_spec='none' (opt-out sentinel). Does NOT delete {voice_file}_spec.json or the overlay poster. Must be sent ALONE. Re-enable later via (B) Upload Overlay.
